messages.content: 哪三種植物最適合用於防止山坡侵蝕？

function.name: get_plants_for_slope
function.description: Retrieve the list of plants suitable for slope based on erosion control ability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

slope_type.description: The type of slope like steep, moderate etc.

num_results.description: The number of top results needed. Default is 5.

message.content: 請問您想針對哪種類型的山坡（例如陡峭、適中等）來選擇防止侵蝕的植物？這樣我才能為您提供最合適的建議。
